column1: # Where update.py reads which company publishes which app (ADR 0020). Columns: entity, method, location.
#   asset-links  the company's own Digital Asset Links file: every Android app it names, with the SHA-256
#                of its signing certificate, is the company's (grade 1). A file may name a partner's app
#                that shares the company's sign-in; such an entry can be disputed (data/CORRECTIONS.md);
#   sdk-needs    the certificates of a service's genuine packages in data/sdk-needs, read from the
#                company's own client library (grade 1); location: the service.
